title: Endometrium Collagenase Protocol
author: Roser Vento-Tormo
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.65hhg36
materials: Tighten lid and then seal with parafilm.

steps.title: Preserve tissue (optional)
steps.instruction: If needed, flash‑freeze tissue in isopentane for spatial transcriptomics, or keep tissue on ice in HypoThermosol® FRS (4 °C) for transport; store samples in formalin for RNA‑Scope or flash‑freeze for nuclei sequencing.

steps.title: Remove blood vessels (optional)
steps.instruction: Scrape off visible blood vessels from the remaining tissue; skip this step if the donor was perfused.

steps.title: Mince tissue
steps.instruction: Place wet tissue under a petri dish, use two scalpels to roughly mince the tissue to increase digestion efficiency.

steps.title: Add collagenase mix
steps.instruction: Transfer the minced tissue to a 50 mL Falcon tube containing the collagenase mix (approximately 3 mL per piece of tissue, volume may vary with tissue size).

steps.title: Digest tissue
steps.instruction: Incubate the tube at 37 °C for 45 minutes with shaking (recommended).

steps.title: Resuspend in RPMI
steps.instruction: After incubation, resuspend the digested material with 20 mL RPMI containing 10 % serum.

steps.title: Filter suspension
steps.instruction: Pass the suspension through a 100 µm strainer; do not discard the retained tissue, which will be used for the Endometrium‑Trypsin protocol.

steps.title: Centrifuge filtrate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the filtered material at 450 g (0.5 rcf) for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Wash cell pellet
steps.instruction: Wash the resulting pellet twice with 10 mL PBS each time.

substeps.instruction: Add 10 mL PBS, resuspend, and centrifuge as above.
Repeat the wash with another 10 mL PBS.

steps.title: Resuspend for counting
steps.instruction: Resuspend the washed pellet in 1 mL RPMI with 10 % serum, count cells, and sort the desired population according to the “Cell staining for flow cytometry and sorting” protocol.

steps.title: RBC lysis (optional)
steps.instruction: For biopsy samples only: resuspend cells in 2–4 mL 1× RBC lysis buffer and incubate 10 minutes; prepare 1× RLB by diluting the 10× stock with water; after lysis add 10 mL RPMI 10 % and centrifuge at 450 g for 5 minutes; wash the pellet twice with 10 mL PBS.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend cells in 2–4 mL 1× RBC lysis buffer.
Dilute 10× RBC lysis buffer stock with water to make 1× solution (RLB preparation).
Add 10 mL RPMI 10 % to the lysed sample.

steps.title: Freeze cells (optional)
steps.instruction: Resuspend cells in freezing medium to a concentration of 1 × 10⁷ cells per mL and aliquot into cryogenic storage vials.

steps.title: Final PBS wash (optional)
steps.instruction: Wash the tissue with PBS if desired.
